note: E148: every deprecated route, one entry each, sorted by route. kind alias = a legacy template outside the OpenAPI paths (listed under info.x-ophiolite-deprecated-aliases); kind operation = an OpenAPI path marked deprecated: true. since is the Deprecation date (RFC 9745, 00:00:00Z), sunset the Sunset date (RFC 8594, 00:00:00 GMT); successor names the public route an operation's Link points at; methods maps the legacy-only /rpc methods to theirs. A route is removed only after its sunset and its condition (docs/api-versioning.md, transition step 3); the gateway's tests fail once a sunset has passed and the route still answers.
